claim: White wins on its first move and Black's forced reply.
change: setup: White's whole army is one queen, on d1; Black's army is as usual.

proof.text: Captures are compulsory (`rules.must_capture`). White's only legal move is Qd1xd7 (the d-file is open to d7). Every Black legal reply is then a capture of the queen on d7, which leaves White with no pieces, and `rules.extinction` (any piece, fewer than 1, result win) gives White the game. The certificate lists White's move and every Black reply, each ending the game as White's win; `labelled/verify.py` walks it.
